title: Token Cost Index Entry
description: One measured record of token consumption for a defined business task. Mirrors supabase/migrations/001_initial.sql, which is the source of truth. Used for client-side validation (via zod, generated from this file) and for validating dataset exports.

task_name.description: Plain-language name for the task. Example: 'Supplier invoice field extraction'.

task_unit.description: The unit costs are measured against. Example: 'per invoice', 'per contract clause'.

calls_per_unit.description: Average API calls per task unit. Agentic workflows are usually well above 1.

includes_retries.description: True if the token figures include failed calls and retries.

input_tokens_median.description: Median input tokens per task unit, summed across all calls.

input_tokens_p90.description: Optional. 90th percentile input tokens per task unit. Must be >= median.

sample_size.description: Number of task units measured. Minimum 10.

measurement_date.description: When the measurement was taken. Model behaviour changes over time.

methodology.description: How tokens were measured: billing dashboard, API response usage fields, logging middleware. Include input document characteristics. This field is the trust mechanism.

source_url.description: Optional link to a write-up, benchmark, or public evidence.
